text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Returning from the island, {0} sat down at his desk, intent on completing his remaining homework, but there was only a short time left until the end of summer vacation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
島から帰った{0}は、
残る宿題を片づけるため一心不乱に机に向かい続けていたが、
夏休み終了まで残りわずかな時間しか残されていなかった。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Judging by the progress of my Beloved {0}'s homework... no matter how I sugarcoat it, he won't make it in time for the deadline...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}様の宿題の進み具合を見る限り、
提出期限に間に合うのはどう考えても……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Don't say that, Eriko-chan! He's just working on the drill workbook now, right? If we help, he’ll make it in time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと言っちゃダメだよエリコちゃん！
今やってるのはドリルだったよね？
私たちが手伝えば間に合うよ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's right. I won’t allow anything to spoil your precious summer break, my Beloved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
あなた様の夏休みを台無しにするなど
許されませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Uuuu... I'm really happy that you're so well-behaved, but I really want to help. I wonder if there's anything I can do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ～
品行方正な弟くんで
すごくうれしいけど、
でもお手伝いしたいよ。
何かないのかな……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Something we can do for my Beloved {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何か、
{0}様のためにできることは……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...HAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ハッ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: His summer break...
text_block_list.orig_text: 夏休みを……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: We just have to make sure it doesn't end...
text_block_list.orig_text: 終わらせなければいいんだ……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Let’s make it happen.
text_block_list.orig_text: やりましょう。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I'm in.
text_block_list.orig_text: やろう。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing! More importantly, if we linger here, we'll be in your way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
何でもない！
それより
私たちが居たら邪魔しちゃうよね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We'll be taking our leave. We trust that you will complete your homework.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
私たちはお暇させていただきます。
あなた様が宿題を完遂させること、
信じておりますわ。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: See you later, little brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあね、
弟くん。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I hope you're ready for this, Eriko-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
覚悟はいいね、
エリコちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kuskus... what a pointless worry...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス……
愚問ですわ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru Eriko
text_block_list.text: Everything...
text_block_list.orig_text: すべては……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru Eriko
text_block_list.text: For my little brother! For my Beloved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弟くんのために！
あなた様のために！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: My Beloved... I wish you the best of luck... Farewell.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた様、
どうかご健勝で……
さようなら。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Onee-chan... will always think of you, little brother...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんは
いつでも弟くんのことを想ってるからね……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Eriko and Shizuru cast a wistful gaze at {0}’s back as he worked at his desk... then quietly disappeared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
机に向かう{0}の背中に
切なげな視線を向けたエリコとシズルは、
静かに姿を消すのであった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At dawn, as the sun began to rise, two strange figures stood at Lucent Academy... just as a new semester was about to begin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
朝陽が昇り始めたばかりの早朝。
新たな学期を迎えようとするルーセント学院に、
不釣り合いな姿をした者たちがいた。

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: Ummm, young ladies... You don't look like any of our students. What are you doing here dressed like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～
お嬢さんがた……
うちの生徒には見えないけど、
そんな姿で何してるんだい？

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: The pool is no longer open to the public, so there's no point in waiting here, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
プールの一般開放はもう終わってるから、
ここで待ってても仕方ないよ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: As long as we're here, summer vacation will never end!! WE WON'T LET IT END!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちがいる限り
夏休みは終わらない！！　
終わらせない！！

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: .........Huh? I’ve got no idea what you’re going on about, but I’m gonna have to ask you to leave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………は？
何を言っとるのかわからんが、
出ていってもらわないと困るよ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: We’re not going anywhere.
text_block_list.orig_text: 出ていきません。

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: Why? If you just stay here, you won't be able to enter the pool either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで？　
ここにいても
プールには入れないよ？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: We have only ONE demand: Do NOT start the opening ceremony!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちの要求はただ一つ。
始業式を始めないこと！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: If you dare to start it... we'll destroy this school!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし始めようと言うなら、
この学校を破壊します！

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: Don't say such scary things now. I'm just doing my job here... don't make me call the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなおっかないこと言わないで。
おじさん仕事だから
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】を
呼ばなきゃいけなくなっちゃうよ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter. No matter what enemies come our way, we will stick to our demands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
構いませんわ。
どんな敵が来ようと
私たちは要求を貫き通すだけです。

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? I'm... really going to report you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいんだね？
おじさん
本当に通報しちゃうからね！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: When I heard the report, I thought it was a prank at first, but... There really are protesting women in swimsuits. This must be some kind of nightmare...
text_block_list.orig_text:
通報を聞いてイタズラかと思ったが……
本当に水着姿の女がいるな。
これは何かの悪い夢か……

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I can see them myself, so it can't be a dream... Well, let's just move them out of the way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分にも見えるので
残念ながら夢ではありませんね……
まぁ、
適当にどいてもらいましょう。

text_block_list.name: Soldier 1
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!? Captain, look at one of these women! Th-That's... the Destroyer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？　
隊長、
女の一人を見てください！
あ、
あれは……
壊し屋です！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: No, no, there's no way the Destroyer would be here... SHE IS!!! No matter how you look at it, that's the Destroyer!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
壊し屋がこんなところに居るわけ…………
あった！！！！
あれはどう見ても壊し屋じゃないか！！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Use communication magic to urgently request backup! Also wake up those off duty! Call in everyone who can come!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
至急
通信魔法で応援を要請しろ！
非番のやつもたたき起こせ！　
来られるやつは全員招集だ！！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: LOCK DOWN THE WHOLE AREA!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたり一帯も封鎖しろ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: How dramatic... If you’d simply accepted our demands, none of this would’ve been necessary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな大げさな……
要求を呑んでくれさえすれば
何もいたしませんのに……

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text: Two battalions have arrived in response to your request for reinforcement... but... was it really necessary for them to come?
text_block_list.orig_text:
応援要請により
二個大隊到着いたしました……
が、
本当に来る必要ありました？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text: I was wondering what kind of person this so called Destroyer was... but it's just a small woman. I'm more than enough for her. Hey, don't do anything stupid and just get out of he-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
壊し屋なんて言うから
どんな奴が居るのかと思えば、
ただの女じゃないですか。
あんなの
俺一人で十分ですよ。
おい、
バカなことやってないでさっさと出てい……

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: IDIOT! DON'T GET TOO CLOSE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
馬鹿！　
迂闊に近づくな！！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Onee-chan... CHOOOOOOOOOOOOP!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんチョ～～
ップ！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 2
text_block_list.text: GUEH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐへっ！

text_block_list.name: Soldier 3
text_block_list.text: How can this be?! One of our elites was taken down with one blow by a woman who's not even the Destroyer?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな！？
うちの精鋭が
壊し屋でもない女に一撃で！？

text_block_list.name: Soldier 3
text_block_list.text: I won't let you make a fool of me!! I'll subdue you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舐められてたまるか！！　
制圧するぞ！！

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おう！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: W-Wait! We don't know who that other girl is, but you're being too careless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待て！
相手の素性が分からんのに迂闊に……

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: As I said... I WON'T LET YOU PASS!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
ここは通しません、
わっ！

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAAAAA!?

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: I know I just said not to be careless, but... I guess it can't be helped now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言わんこっちゃない……
が、
こうなっては仕方ないか。

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: EVERYONE! Hold them down with all your might!! Don’t let your guard down for a second!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全員、
全力で取り押さえろ！！　
一切気を抜くな！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: No way... If you just hadn't allowed the opening ceremony to start, we wouldn't have done anything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
始業式を始めさえしなければ、
何もしないのに……

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text: GWWEEEEHHH~?!

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Just how many have I defeated so far? How about you, Eriko-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今ので何人倒したかな？
エリコちゃんは何人？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Who knows... I stopped counting after 100...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ……？
100から先は数えていませんわ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Me too. But it's getting a little tiring, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も～
でもちょっとしんどくなってきたかな？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: You can go and rest if you want. I'll take care of the rest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
倒れるなら倒れて構いませんよ。
あとは私がなんとかしますから。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Hehe... You said that just to avoid me from pushing myself, didn’t you? You’re actually really sweet, Eriko-chan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
そう言えば私が張り合うって分かってるんでしょ？
エリコちゃんほんとはやさしいもんね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: W-What are you talking about!? I didn’t mean it like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何を！　
私はそんなつもりで言ってませんわ！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Y-You girls... What are you really after...? What does it matter if the opening ceremony starts...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お前たち……
本当に何が目的なんだ……
始業式が始まらなければ
なんだっていうんだ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: It's all to keep summer break from ending!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 夏休みを終わらせないためだよ！！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: The two of us are just buying time for my Beloved {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちはただ
{0}様の時間を稼ぐだけです！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Buying time?! A-Are you saying there's someone even worse than you two coming?! Only the Commander could deal with someone like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
時間稼ぎだと！？
お、
お前らよりヤバいやつが来るっていうのか！？
そんな化け物に対処できるのなんて
団長くらいしか……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: This sound...!
text_block_list.orig_text: この……！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: These footsteps...!
text_block_list.orig_text: 足音は……！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me this monster has arrived?! H-HELP! I don't want to die yet! I have a fiancée I left behind in my hometown!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
化け物が来てしまったというのか！？
た、
助けてくれ！　
まだ死にたくない！
故郷に残してきた婚約者がいるんだ！！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Little Brother!
text_block_list.orig_text: 弟くん！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: My Beloved...!
text_block_list.orig_text: あなた様……！

text_block_list.name: Captain
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: This summer vacation is over without incident!
text_block_list.orig_text: 無事に夏休み終了だね！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Yes... It's regrettable to say, but our production is now over...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ……
名残惜しいですが、
私たちのプロデュースも終わりですわ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE looked confused, Eriko and Shizuru looked up at the sky with deep emotions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
戸惑いの表情を浮かべる
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】をよそに、
エリコとシズルは感慨深い表情で空を仰いでいた。
